table.title: 2024年重点信息化项目执行情况汇总表
table.html:
项目负责人预算（万元）进度风险说明
市级政务云平台二期扩容李建国1,280.00已完成招标，进入设备到货验收阶段，整体进度约 45%原定 6 月到货的核心交换机因上游芯片供应紧张推迟至 8 月中旬，若不能在 9 月前完成上架联调，将影响四季度各区县业务系统迁移窗口；同时机房 A 区承重改造尚未取得消防复核意见，需同步协调机关事务管理局，建议提前锁定备选机房资源并预留 15 天缓冲期。
不动产登记“一网通办”改造周敏365.50需求确认完成，开发完成 60%，UAT 测试计划已排期与自然资源部新版接口规范存在字段口径差异，存量 12 万条历史数据需清洗映射，外包团队两名骨干 7 月离职导致开发节奏放缓；另外区级窗口人员培训尚未启动，存在上线后操作不熟练引发投诉的风险。
城市运行体征监测系统陈志远742.00已完成初验，正在按专家意见整改，进度约 88%接入的 9 类物联感知设备中，水务与燃气两家单位数据接口仍为人工导出方式，实时性无法满足监测要求；数据共享协议尚未签署，存在上线后部分指标空跑的风险，需由数据资源局牵头在本月底前完成协调。
机关内部协同办公平台信创迁移王雪松198.60已完成 3 个试点处室迁移，计划 10 月全量推广部分老旧业务插件不兼容国产操作系统，需厂商提供适配版本，目前仅有一家厂商响应；终端替换数量比摸底时增加约 120 台，预算缺口约 18 万元，建议按“先机关后事业”分批实施，避免一次性切换造成业务中断。
公共数据授权运营试点赵一鸣520.00方案已报市政府审定，尚未正式启动实施授权运营的定价机制与收益分配比例仍在与财政局会商，法律合规意见尚未出具；首批拟开放的交通、医疗两类数据涉及个人信息脱敏，安全评估周期预计不少于 60 天，年内完成试点验收的难度较大，建议将考核节点调整为“完成首批产品上线”而非“形成完整运营规模”。
table.brief: 只有一行数据的宽表：项目 / 负责人 / 预算 / 进度 / 风险说明（长）

understanding.purpose: A one-page management summary of 2024 IT project execution: each row is a project, and readers check owner, budget, progress narrative and risk note together — the table is read row-by-row for status, and column-by-column only for budget or risk comparisons.
understanding.reading: The eye enters at the project name (the row's identity), jumps right to 预算 for the money figure, then reads 进度 and 风险说明 as two prose fields that carry the actual status story. 负责人 is a small lookup field consulted occasionally, so it should be narrow but still show the full name on one line. Because the two prose columns are long, rows are already multi-line tall, so wrapping there costs nothing; the project name and the budget figure are what must stay legible at a glance.
groups: col 1 项目 — row identity, must anchor each row
col 2 负责人 — short lookup attribute of the row, sits next to the project name
col 3 预算（万元） — numeric comparison column, must stay whole and right-aligned in feel
col 4 进度 and col 5 风险说明 — twin prose fields, both naturally wrap, should be sized as a pair rather than independently
keep_intact: 预算（万元） header (60px unbreakable) and all budget figures such as 1,280.00 — never split or wrapped
负责人 header and the 3-character names on one line
项目 names: at minimum no mid-word break of identifiers like “一网通办”, “信创迁移”; ideally whole on one or two lines
进度/风险说明: keep phrases like “UAT 测试计划”, “3 个试点处室迁移”, “60%” unbroken
may_wrap: 进度 sentences (already multi-line in every row)
风险说明 paragraphs (very long, will always wrap to many lines — the main absorber of width)

preferred.name: r2B
preferred.note: The compromise I'd actually publish: 项目 131px stays inside the clean 8-character zone (no widows, names break 8 + rest), 进度 rises to 127px so its sentences read as ~8-character lines instead of a 7-character ladder, and 风险说明 still holds the largest share at 217px (~14 characters/line). Costs roughly 30px of height versus r1B and buys a readable status column.

acceptable.name: r1B
acceptable.note: Push r0C's best instinct further: 风险说明 is 1830px of content and sets every row's height, so give it 248px (≈8 lines instead of 14 in r0A). 项目 150px is the minimum where names still break at a phrase boundary, 进度 140px is enough for 3 short lines, and 预算 stays at 113px so its header never splits.

acceptable.name: r2A
acceptable.note: Keep r1B's proven 项目 (129px = clean 8-character breaks, zero orphans) and its minimal 负责人/预算, but take 10px back from 进度 and hand 14px to 风险说明 (231px of text, ~15 characters per line). Result should be at or below r1B's 1009px while giving 进度 slightly more breathing room than the 7-character ladder it had.

acceptable.name: r3C
acceptable.note: 测试相反的假设：既然风险说明列最长（单行内容需要 1830px），并且它决定了行高，那么给风险说明列宽裕的 276px（255px 文字宽度，每行约 17 个字符）也许能把最高的行从 9 行降到 8 行，从而拉低整个表格的高度。进度列缩到 142px（文字宽度 121px），因此这次测试会显示：更宽的风险说明列带来的行数减少，是否足以弥补进度列变窄。如果高度保持在 1009px，这个设计就比 r3-balanced 差；如果高度下降，风险说明列的主导地位就得到确认。

acceptable.name: r3B
acceptable.note: 尝试一种真正把进度列当作第二正文列的设计：项目列缩到 122px（名称折成 2–3 行，对行高没有成本），进度列升到 176px（文字宽度 155px，每行约 10 个字符），而风险说明列保持在 240px（219px 文字宽度），这是 r2B 的测试表明该列大约在 217px 文字宽度处仍能保持 6 行的高度。这个设计用一点项目列名称易读性，换取进度列句子更平稳的换行。

acceptable.name: r1C
acceptable.note: Alternative emphasis: treat 项目 as the anchor the eye enters on and give it 185px so all names land on one or two lines with no awkward break, at the cost of 15px from 风险说明 (208px, still ~9 lines). 进度 145px keeps its 3-line shape and 预算 113px keeps the header whole.

bad.name: r2C
bad.note: Tests the opposite trade-off: 进度 at 139px gets a near-ideal ~9-character measure and stops producing 5-line ladders, at the price of 风险说明 shrinking to 207px (~13.5 characters) and a table near r1A's height. Worth seeing because 进度 is the column readers scan for status, and the risk column stays readable down to ~13 characters — but note the two prose columns should NOT be made equal (their one-line widths are 373 vs 1830), so 风险说明 must keep a clear majority of the leftover width.
bad.why: It hands the dominant 风险说明 column only 228px (207px of text) while giving 项目 148 and 进度 162, and those extra pixels buy no shorter wrapping: two rows overflow to an extra line and the table grows to 1079px against 1009px for r1B/r2A, which are otherwise the same design. Costly, with no visible gain.

bad.name: r3A
bad.note: 以 r2B 为起点：从项目列拿走 22px（152→130；名称仍折成 2–3 行，这在 176–222px 高的行中不增加成本），并把这 22px 分给进度列（+14，文字宽度 139px）和风险说明列（+8，文字宽度 225px）。进度列现在每行约 9.3 个字符，风险说明列安全地保持在断行门槛之上，因此预计表格高度仍为 1009px。
bad.why: 130px leaves 109px of text, which quantizes to exactly 7 characters per line — the worst possible band here. It cuts 监测, 运营, 办公 and the quoted 一网通办 mid-word (城市运行体征监/测系统, 公共数据授权运/营试点, 机关内部协同办/公平台信创迁移), whereas the 6-character designs (r3B/r3C) only damage 平台, and the 8-character ones only 二期.

bad.name: contrast
bad.note: The tempting 'balanced/equal columns' answer. 负责人 needs 45px of glyphs and gets 123; 预算 needs 92 and gets 123; meanwhile 风险说明, whose one-line width is 1830px, is squeezed to 122px of text (≈8 characters), so every risk note becomes 12–16 lines and the table roughly doubles in height. Symmetry actively destroys the reading column.
bad.why: The tempting 'balanced/equal columns' answer. 负责人 needs 45px of glyphs and gets 123; 预算 needs 92 and gets 123; meanwhile 风险说明, whose one-line width is 1830px, is squeezed to 122px of text (≈8 characters), so every risk note becomes 12–16 lines and the table roughly doubles in height. Symmetry actively destroys the reading column.

rationale: This is a risk-register table: the 风险说明 prose is the substance readers actually read, so it deserves the widest column (≈14 characters/line), while 负责人 and 预算 are fixed-width facts that should stay tight — 68px and 113px are already the exact minimum where 预算（万元） holds one line. r2B is preferred because its 进度 width (148px → 8 characters) keeps clause units like 到货验收阶段 intact, whereas r1B and r2A at 136–140px split 验收阶/段 in the first row; all three render at the same 1009px height, so the progress column is the only discriminator. r1C buys a clean 项目 column (the quoted 一网通办 survives, two project names fit on one line) but pays 140px of extra table height and squeezes the risk prose to 12 characters/line, which is the wrong trade for this content. r3C is the compact extreme: 893px and the shortest table, at the price of a 6-character project column that breaks 平台 and the quoted term — publishable, but the row labels become less scannable.

general: A prose column whose one-line width is an order of magnitude larger than the others should receive the surplus width; symmetry across such a table is a fault, not a virtue.
Short identity columns (names, codes, units) should sit at their exact one-line minimum plus a few px — extra width there is pure white space taken from the reading column.

Measure text in whole characters, not pixels: with CJK at a fixed size, width bands of 15px decide whether a term like 监测 or a quoted program name is cut, so the 'same' layout can be good or bad after a 4px change.
A 4–8px width change that pushes two rows over a line boundary and adds 70px of table height is a real cost even though the widths look identical.
specific: 风险说明 dominates this table (1830px one-line); the optimal allocation is roughly 55–65% of the total width to it.
项目 names here are 10–14 characters, so they always wrap to 2–3 lines; the only question is whether they break at word boundaries — 8 characters/line (141–155px) is the least damaging band available.
预算（万元） is at its hard floor at 113px; the header cannot wrap and the numbers are short, so this column should never be widened or narrowed.
Row heights are driven entirely by the risk cell, so 进度 and 项目 wrapping costs no height until it exceeds ~8–9 lines — the reason several quite different width splits all land on 1009px.

tradeoffs: Whether identifier integrity outranks the reading column: r1C (185px 项目) is the only design where 一网通办 stays whole and two project names fit on one line, and a designer preparing a printed annex might accept 1149px and a 12-character risk column for that. The opposite camp prefers r3C's 893px and lets project names break at 6 characters, betting that readers recognize rows from the first few glyphs.
uncertain: All the 项目 judgements rest on glyph quantization: at 148–152px the quoted term misses fitting by only 3–5px, so a slightly different font metric or quote width could flip several verdicts. Whether a mid-word CJK break (平台, 监测) reads as a fault to a Chinese-locale audience at 15px is also arguable — CJK permits breaks anywhere — and r1C's single orphan character (容) may be considered worse than a clean 6-character break.

critique.good: 项目 column is generous (210px) so the row identity reads immediately and most names sit on one line; 负责人 is tight and correct; the hierarchy project → owner → money → prose is clear.
critique.problems: The table is enormous (1544px, rows up to 339px). 风险说明 collapses into a 145px ribbon of 14 lines — a wall of stacked characters that is slow to read and makes every row balloon. Meanwhile 项目/预算/进度 cells are half-empty vertical space, so the reader's eye runs down a narrow column of text next to three near-blank blocks. The 预算（万元） header still breaks into two lines.
critique.cause: 166px for 风险说明 (145px of text) is far too little for the column that is 1830px of content — it is the sole height driver. 210px on 项目 buys nothing beyond one-line names, and 100px on 预算 is under the 113px needed for the 60px header to stay whole.

critique.good: Much better balance: the two prose columns (195/196) are treated as the pair they are, and height drops to 1265px. Project column at 160px keeps rows legible as units and 负责人 stays a clean one-line lookup.
critique.problems: Still tall because 风险说明 only gets 175px of text and runs 11 lines. 进度 is given nearly the same width as 风险说明 even though its content is ~5× shorter, so ~40px of width is wasted there while the tallest column is starved. 项目 names break mid-phrase (“一网通办”改造 splits across the line). 预算（万元） header wraps again.
critique.cause: Equal widths for unequal content (195 vs 196) plus a 100px budget column. The height is set by 风险说明, so any pixel taken from 进度 and given to 风险说明 shortens every row.

critique.good: By far the best proportion and rhythm: 963px, rows 153–199px, risk at 260px reads as a proper paragraph, and the whole table fits a page with the status story visible at a glance.
critique.problems: 项目 at 140px is too cramped — identifiers break mid-word (“协同办|公平台信创迁移”, “一网通|办”改造), which damages the row's identity. 预算 at 96px is below the threshold, so “预算（万/元）” splits and the money figure looks squeezed against its neighbours. 进度 at 155px produces ragged 3–4 line blocks that visually compete with the risk text.
critique.cause: 96 < 113px needed for the 预算 header; 140px is under the ~165px where project names break on a sensible boundary rather than mid-phrase.

critique.good: The widest 风险说明 (223px) of the set keeps the risk paragraphs to ~10 lines, and 项目 at 165px reads as a real identity column, not a sliver. 负责人 (68) and 预算 (113) are minimal but intact, so the budget figures and 3-character names stay whole.
critique.problems: The project column is in an awkward zone: 城市运行体征监测系统 breaks as '…监测系 / 统' (one-character widow) and 不动产登记"一网通 / 办"改造 splits the quoted project identifier. 进度 at 150px is also middling — long enough to lose its ladder shape but not long enough to give a comfortable measure, and the table is 1079px tall, 7% taller than r1B for no gain in the risk column.
critique.cause: 项目 gets 144px of text — just above the 9-character mark (9×15=135, 10×15=150). Every 10-character name therefore fills 9 characters and dumps a single character on line 2. The extra 15px spent on 项目 bought nothing; it should have gone to 风险说明.

critique.good: The shortest, calmest table (1009px) with a genuinely even rhythm — rows 2–4 all settle at 176px because 风险说明 at 248px gives the dominant prose column a comfortable ~15-character measure. 项目 at 150px is accidentally well chosen: 129px of text fits exactly 8 characters, so every project name breaks 8 + remainder with no orphans anywhere.
critique.problems: 进度 is starved: at 119px it is a 7-character ladder, wrapping '已完成招标，进入 / 设备到货验收阶 / 段，整体进度 / 约 45%' into five ragged lines with '45%' and 'UAT 测试计划' stranded. 项目 is also slightly too tight for the quoted name — 不动产登记"一网通 / 办"改造 cuts 一网通办 in half.
critique.cause: 风险说明 took 248px (34% of the table) and 进度 was the sole donor at 140px. Because every 风险说明 cell is long, the row height is set almost entirely by that one column, so 进度's width is nearly free — the 20px taken from it bought only ~25px of height while costing real readability.

critique.good: 项目 at 185px is the only design where 城市运行体征监测系统 and 公共数据授权运营试点 sit on one line and 不动产登记"一网通办"改造 keeps the quoted identifier whole — the most respectful treatment of row identity.
critique.problems: It is the tallest table (1149px, +14% vs r1B) and the risk column becomes an 11-line wall of text — exactly the column readers must actually read. Meanwhile 项目 still fails elsewhere: 市级政务云平台二期扩 / 容 leaves a one-character widow and 机关内部协同办公平台 / 信创迁移 breaks at 平台.
critique.cause: 项目 was pushed past the clean break point: at 164px of text, 10-character names fit exactly and 12-character names leave 10 + 1. Any 项目 width between roughly 135 and 165 produces widows because the 10- and 12-character names fall just short of a full line. The 30px over-spent on 项目 came straight out of 风险说明, which is the single column that controls table height.

critique.good: 项目列（150px）读起来很清楚，名称能整齐地折成两行；风险说明列（252px）每行约 15 个字符，是三个设计中最易读的长文本列；整个表格保持 1009px，所有行高都稳定在 176–222px。
critique.problems: 进度列非常局促：文字宽度只有 115px，每行约 7.5 个字符，因此进度句会断成 4–5 个短行，而且断点常落在短语中间（“进 / 入设备到货验收”、“验收阶 / 段，整体进度 / 约 45%”）。读这一列时，视线会沿着参差不齐的短行移动，而它又是与项目名称并列的“当前状态”信息。同时，风险说明列比实际需要更宽：它每行 231px，但行高与 r2B 的 217px 版本完全相同，所以这多出来的宽度没有减少任何一行。
critique.cause: 列宽在项目/进度/风险之间的分配偏向了错误的列：把风险说明列从 238 拉到 252，只买到了空余空间（9 行中仍占 9 行），却牺牲了进度列 12px 的宽度；而进度列本来就是最窄的正文列。

critique.good: 三个设计中综合表现最好：表高同样是 1009px，但进度列每行约 8.5 个字符（127px），比 r2A 更自然；风险说明列（238px → 217px 文字宽度）仍然让第 2–5 行的风险单元格保持 6 行，因此表格高度没有增加。负责人列（68px）和预算列（113px）尺寸合适，所有数字和负责人姓名都保持在一行。
critique.problems: 进度列仍然偏窄：换行会断在短语内部（“进入设备到货验收阶 / 段”、“开 / 发完成 60%”、“按专家意见整 / 改”）。项目列（152px）有大量垂直空余：名称折成 2 行后，下面还有 4–5 行空白，而右边进度列却在争抢每一像素。另外，风险说明列的宽度正好卡在断行门槛上，所以这个设计几乎没有余量。
critique.cause: 项目列宽度过大，把本可给进度列的 12–30px 占用了；行高由风险说明列决定，因此项目列折成 3 行本来也不会带来额外成本。

critique.good: 进度列（162px → 141px 文字宽度）是三个设计中读起来最舒服的：每行约 9.4 个字符，所以行在“进入设备到货验收阶段，”这样的短语边界处断开；这里项目列也收窄了，所以项目列/进度列的平衡感看起来是对的。
critique.problems: 表格整体变高了：行高从 176px 变成 199px（第 3–5 行），最后一行变成 246px，表格高度达到 1079px，最长单元格 10 行。更糟的是，表格下方空白很多，却没有得到补偿。风险说明列现在读起来很紧张：每行只有约 13.8 个字符，句子会在短语中间断开（“仍为人 / 工导出方式”、“完成协 / 调”）。
critique.cause: 风险说明列缩到 228px（207px 文字宽度）后，越过了断行门槛，风险单元格因此增加一行；而风险说明是长度约为进度列 5 倍的正文列，它的行数决定了表格高度。从风险说明列拿走 14px，让整个表格多出 70px。

review.method: two fresh-context blind reviews; letters shuffled; includes browser auto layout and equal widths as neutral references

r2C.why: All five headers sit on one line and 项目 (~147px) comfortably holds two-line project names, but 风险说明 — the column carrying roughly five times the text of any other — is the narrowest of the balanced variants (~260px), so it breaks into many short lines and inflates every row, leaving 负责人/预算 with large empty gaps.

r2A.why: Proportions follow the content: 项目 ~142px, 负责人 ~75px, 预算 ~105px (header still on one line), 进度 ~135px, and the dominant 风险说明 gets the largest share (~265px). Names stay horizontal, numbers stay intact, and rows are visibly shorter than in A while the left columns are not over-fed.

r2B.why: Readable and well ordered, but it squeezes 项目 to ~132px and 负责人 to ~65px without giving 风险说明 more room than B, so project titles wrap slightly more and the risk text is no better off — a small loss for no gain.

r1B.why: Very close to B: 风险说明 is the widest of the balanced set (~280px) so the bulk of the reading matter gets the space it needs, while 项目 (~142px) still takes two lines, 进度 ~135px reads cleanly, and 负责人 at ~65px still holds three-character names on one line.

ref_equal.why: The risk column is cramped for its volume and the rows grow very tall; the short left columns (项目, 负责人, 预算) end up as mostly white space, so a row no longer reads as a unit and the eye has to travel far to pair a risk note with its project. Structure is intact, rhythm is not.

ref_auto.why: Risk text finally gets room, but at the cost of the identifying columns: 项目 is crushed to ~90px, the header 负责人 stacks vertically and names read character-by-character (李/建/国), 预算（万元）breaks awkwardly, and 进度 is so narrow that short phrases become vertical strips — the table can no longer be scanned by project or owner.

raw.unsure: Exact column widths are estimated from the rendered images (A–D differ by only ~10–20px per column), so B and D may be effectively the same layout; also unknown whether the target is screen or A4 print, which could shift the ideal balance slightly toward a wider 项目 column.

r2A.why: Risk column gets generous width and the header row stays intact, but 进度 is squeezed into a very narrow strip, causing choppy four-line status cells and a near-orphan in one row.

ref_auto.why: 负责人 is far too narrow: the header stacks vertically and names split across lines; 项目 and 进度 are also cramped while 风险说明 dominates, breaking the header hierarchy and row rhythm.

r2C.why: Balanced allocation: 项目 wraps cleanly to two lines, 负责人 and 预算 stay on one line, 进度 is readable in three lines, and 风险说明—the long prose column—gets the largest share without starving the others.

r1B.why: Readable and orderly, but 进度 is given more width than its short content needs while 风险说明 is narrowed, producing more line breaks in the long risk notes and a less natural hierarchy.

ref_equal.why: The hierarchy is inverted: 进度 receives the widest column despite short content, while 风险说明 is the narrowest and runs to many lines, making rows very tall and the table feel vertically bloated.

r2B.why: Close to C and generally well proportioned; all headers remain intact and 进度 is comfortable, though 风险说明 is slightly narrower than ideal for the dominant prose column.
